snippet.title: Dominot - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4294350/Dominot/

Dominot is a narrative mystery roguelike where you use domino pieces as part of a forbidden ritual, blending elements of point-and-click adventures with ever-shifting interfaces and hidden horrors. As the questions grow, so do the features hidden inside the game...
